fideon:note: Repo-defined line with no equivalent in the supplied drop. Core re-based on policy_core v1.4.0 by scripts/build_canonical_policy_schemas.py; the 3 line-specific block(s) are the repo's own and are kept verbatim. Extended by scripts/canonical_schema_extensions.py with fields the supplied skeleton did not carry; re-run it after any regeneration. Fields carried over from ocean_marine 2026-09-25 (text_sections and printed facts every line of business prints): text_sections, document.print_time, document.print_code, document.source_url, policy.product_code, policy.policy_period_location_basis, billing.billing_note, billing.payment_coupon_scan_line, billing.phone. Fields carried over from SLM L1 2026-09-27 by scripts/slm_l1_additions.py: additional_fields, address full, policy tier/rating state/quote/original inception/cancellation method/renewal offer/term as printed, named insured contact name/occupation/marital status, document endorsement number/delivery preference/e-signature certificate, signature presence, coverages and the math audit rule; re-run it after any regeneration.

fideon:verification.note: source documents exist here, but no field-by-field review of them is recorded

date.note: US insurance documents print dates month/day/year, so every date's parsed value is MM/DD/YYYY: two-digit month and day, four-digit year, whatever the page prints (5/6/26, May 6, 2026 and 2026-05-06 are all parsed as 05/06/2026). raw stays exactly as printed. applies_to matches field names such as effective_date, date_of_birth and replaces_prior_declaration_dated. A form edition_date ("04/07") has no day and keeps its printed form. A value that is not a calendar date ("Full Prior Acts", "None") has parsed null. Compare dates as dates, not strings: as text, 12/31/2025 sorts after 01/01/2026 - this includes the date_ordering audit rules.

endorsement_number.fideon:repo_addition: Printed across the POLICIES-FINAL corpus (277 documents, ~40 carriers) and absent from the supplied schemas. Printed on 11 of the 22 lines. Which endorsement THIS document is. `forms_and_endorsements[]` lists the forms attached to the policy; this names the change the page represents.

delivery_preference.fideon:repo_addition: Printed across the POLICIES-FINAL corpus (277 documents, ~40 carriers) and absent from the supplied schemas. Printed on 4 of the 22 lines. Paper or electronic. A notice sent the way the policyholder did not choose is a compliance failure.

esignature_certificate.fideon:repo_addition: Printed across the POLICIES-FINAL corpus (277 documents, ~40 carriers) and absent from the supplied schemas. Printed on 5 of the 22 lines. The e-signature certificate -- the evidence the document was signed. Same shape as homeowners.

policy_term_as_printed.fideon:repo_addition: The policy term EXACTLY as the page states it, whichever form that takes. Carriers print two: a duration (`Policy Term: 12 Months`) and a date range (`Policy Term: 02/29/2024 to 02/28/2025`). `policy_term_months` counts months, so a carrier printing the range had its date pair written into a numeric field. Keeping both means `policy_term_months` stays a number and the printed form survives as the audit trail.

original_inception_date.fideon:repo_addition: Printed across the POLICIES-FINAL corpus (277 documents, ~40 carriers) and absent from the supplied schemas. Printed on 13 of the 22 lines. The date the policy FIRST incepted, which a renewal states beside its own term -- North Country prints `Inception Date`. Distinct from `effective_date` and from `anniversary_date`.

cancellation_method.fideon:repo_addition: Printed across the POLICIES-FINAL corpus (277 documents, ~40 carriers) and absent from the supplied schemas. Printed on 8 of the 22 lines. HOW a policy was cancelled -- flat, pro-rata, short rate. `cancellation_date` and `cancellation_reason` exist; the method is what decides the refund.

has_signature.fideon:repo_addition: Whether the declarations page carries a signature at all. The `signature` block models the signature's CONTENTS -- representative name, title, dates -- and has no key for its presence. An unsigned declarations page is a compliance question, so `false` is a finding rather than an absence.

text_sections.description: Raw text blocks for SLM/LLM-based policy comparison — populated by the text extraction path, not the VLM FSM. These are what the Comparison API reads.

additional_fields.description: Printed label/value pairs that have no dedicated field above, kept as key and value: the label as the document prints it, the section heading it sits under, and the value as a FieldValue (raw, parsed, page_ref).

parsed.description: The value in its standard form: a number for money and counts, a two-letter code for a state, and MM/DD/YYYY for every date (see fideon:parsed_formats).

TextSection.description: A block of printed text exactly as the document carries it: a prose paragraph, notice, condition or disclaimer, or the page's remaining label/footer text. Nothing the page prints is left out of the gold; structured fields above hold the values, these hold the words.
